svg.title: Unlogic's Optimum Optimill MH50V individual-conductor retrofit diagram
svg.desc: Exact controller, interface, driver, supply and machine terminal labels are joined by separate conductors. Dotted routes are proposed unverified guesses. OPEN breaks identify the missing connection. Numbering is logical, not a mating-face view.

svg.text: DB44 is the machine-side peripheral connector into this Delta drive. Contact functions are from the B3A-L CN1 pin table and
remain conditional on matching the exact drive suffix. Each contact is separately exposed. Owner assigns Alarm/Alarm Reset
only on Z; X/Y DI/DO pins have no owner function assignment. The root-owned shared isolated SON stage may connect here only
after separate DI supply/common domains are checked; do not parallel pin 9 across drives until each COM+ supply and return

text.tspan: Shared servo-on LED drive · all three axes disabled on GPIO reset

svg.text: New engineering proposal: Core GPIO → ULN2003AN → AQY212GS LED, isolated contact pins3/4 to configured machine run circuit.
This slow process interface does not implement E-stop, STO or PWM. Verify startup inactive, receiver mode/current, isolation
layout and loaded off-state leakage before use. Nominal 390 Ω limits LED to approximately 5.5–9 mA using conservative 4.75 V
supply, 1.5 V LED and 1.1 V sink drop assumptions; recheck tolerance/temperature and actual sink voltage. AQY212GS
recommended LED5–30mA, contact≤48V/1A at25°C, derate by temperature; measured receiver current must fit. Contact is
bidirectional and galvanically isolated from the LED side: no logic ground crosses that barrier.

text.tspan: Isolated servo-on contact · three individual drive inputs

svg.text: New shared servo-enable proposal. All three DI circuits must use this verified 24V supply/reference. Do not join unrelated
supply returns. Verify DI1 Servo On parameter on each drive, loaded input current and off leakage. CN1 signal GND29/40 are
separately accounted for and are not automatically the isolated DI return. Retain independent STO/hardware stop and drive
fault handling; this GPIO is not a safety function.
Read the exact per-wire schedule, full contact inventory, parts, configuration and source checks in the accompanying profile.
